title: Most Anticipated Games of 2027 | Confirmed Release Dates | Gaming News
description: The biggest games with confirmed 2027 release dates, from Stranger Than Heaven in January to Final Fantasy VII Revelation in April, plus Witcher 3 and Fallout 76 expansions coming in 2027.

sections.heading: Twenty twenty seven is loaded
sections.script: Twenty twenty six is not even over, and twenty twenty seven already looks like a monster year for gamers. In this video we go through the biggest games that have a confirmed release date in the first months of the year, from Stranger Than Heaven in January to Final Fantasy Seven Revelation in April. We only included games whose dates were reported by at least two reputable sources, and we left out anything that is only a rumor or a loose window. As always, release dates can change, so check the store page before you plan your weekend. Let's start with a very busy January and February.

sections.heading: January: Stranger Than Heaven and Until Dawn Two
sections.script: The first big date is January fifteenth, twenty twenty seven, when Stranger Than Heaven arrives from Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and Sega. It was announced at Summer Game Fest in June of twenty twenty six, and it launches worldwide on PlayStation five, Xbox Series X and S and PC. Later in the month, on January twenty eighth, Sony and the studio Firesprite release Until Dawn Two as a PlayStation five game. The date was revealed in a September State of Play, and the horror sequel follows a new ghost hunting crew who travel to Akishima Island. If you like a story with a strong mood, January has two very different options.

sections.heading: February fourth: Metro twenty thirty nine
sections.script: On February fourth, Deep Silver and 4A Games release Metro twenty thirty nine on PlayStation five, Xbox Series X and S and PC. The game was originally planned for twenty twenty six, and in June the publisher moved it to February of twenty twenty seven. The Metro series has a loyal audience that loves its mix of survival, stealth and atmosphere. With a firm date now set, fans of tense tunnels and scarce ammunition have a good reason to mark the calendar. It is also a nice contrast to the louder games that land later in the month, and a good pick if you prefer slow, careful play over big action set pieces.

sections.heading: February sixteenth: God of War Laufey
sections.script: On February sixteenth, God of War Laufey comes to PlayStation five. Sony announced the date on July twenty fourth at a San Diego Comic Con panel. So far the game has only been confirmed for PlayStation five, and a disc edition is planned. The studio has also said that the next game starring Kratos will connect to Laufey's story, although that one is expected several years later. For many players, a new God of War is an automatic must buy, so it is no surprise that this date is one of the most talked about of the year. Whether you are returning to Kratos or are new to the series, mark this one early, and keep an eye out for pre-order editions and trailers in the coming months.

sections.heading: February eighteenth: Persona Four Revival
sections.script: Two days later, on February eighteenth, Atlus releases Persona Four Revival on PlayStation five, Xbox Series X and S and PC. The date was shown in a trailer at the Xbox Games Showcase in June of twenty twenty six, and the game is a complete rebuild of the classic, with new character models, assets and environments. It was also announced as a day one release on Xbox Game Pass. A Switch Two version is expected to follow later. If you have never visited the foggy town of Inaba, this is a perfect way to start, and fans of the original will be ready to meet the Investigation Team again. With a rebuilt look and a launch on several platforms at once, it could be one of the strongest role playing releases of the whole winter.

sections.heading: February twenty third: Fable
sections.script: Fable launches on February twenty third, twenty twenty seven, for Xbox Series X and S, PlayStation five and PC. It was meant to arrive in fall of twenty twenty six, but Xbox moved it to February so that it would not have to compete with the crowded holiday season, including Grand Theft Auto Six. The date was confirmed in a darker new trailer at the Xbox Games Showcase on June seventh, where the villain Isabel, played by Hayley Atwell, was introduced. Players who buy the Premium Edition can start playing early, on February eighteenth. It is also a Game Pass day one release, so many players will jump in right away.

sections.heading: March fourth: Wo Long Two
sections.script: On March fourth, Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja release Wo Long Two: Wings of Ember on PC, PlayStation five, Xbox Series X and S and Nintendo Switch Two. The story is set in the year two hundred eight and leads up to the Battle of Red Cliffs, following the events of the first Wo Long game. The date was revealed together with a free alpha demo, which gave players an early look at the combat. The game is also coming to Xbox Game Pass. For fans of fast, tough action games inspired by Chinese history, this is the big March release to remember.

sections.heading: April seventh: Exodus
sections.script: On April seventh, Archetype Entertainment releases Exodus, a science fiction action role playing game, on PlayStation five, Xbox Series X and S and PC through Steam and the Epic Games Store. The date was announced at the Opening Night Live show before gamescom in August. The studio was founded by James Ohlen, who spent many years as a creative director at BioWare, and the game is a cinematic single player story. Many fans of the old BioWare style of storytelling are watching this one closely, and now they finally have a date to circle on the calendar.

sections.heading: April eighth: Final Fantasy Seven Revelation
sections.script: The very next day, on April eighth, Square Enix releases Final Fantasy Seven Revelation, the finale of the remake trilogy. The date was announced during PlayStation's State of Play on September third, twenty twenty six, after the game had only been given a spring window before. It launches at the same time on PlayStation five, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch Two and PC. Square Enix also announced two story expansions, one about Sephiroth and one about Vincent and the Turks, planned between winter twenty twenty seven and spring twenty twenty eight. The wait for the ending of this story is almost over.

sections.heading: Big expansions with a twenty twenty seven year
sections.script: Two beloved games are also getting new content next year, although neither has an exact day yet. CD Projekt Red announced a third expansion for The Witcher Three called Songs of the Past, made together with Fool's Theory, and it is planned for twenty twenty seven on PC, PlayStation five and Xbox Series X and S. And Bethesda said that Raven Rock, the next major expansion for Fallout Seventy Six, is coming in twenty twenty seven as a prequel to Fallout Three. Those are only year windows, so expect more details later, but they show how much is still in store for these worlds.

sections.heading: Which one is your day one
sections.script: That is our look at the most anticipated games with confirmed dates in twenty twenty seven, from Stranger Than Heaven on January fifteenth to Final Fantasy Seven Revelation on April eighth. Remember that dates can change, so always check the official store pages. Now it is your turn. Which game is your day one purchase: Fable, God of War Laufey, Persona Four Revival, Exodus or something else? Is there a game you wish had a date? Tell us in the comments. If you enjoyed this video, like it and subscribe for more gaming news, and we will see you in the next one.
